t: You're on Albert Embankment, part of the south bank of the Thames in the London Borough of Lambeth. It stretches about a mile northward, from Vauxhall Bridge to Westminster Bridge, along the river's edge. The name honours Prince Albert, who was Queen Victoria's husband and consort of the monarch from their marriage in 1840 until his death in 1861. Victoria granted him the title Prince Consort in 1857.
